description: How a header value is carried in a NATS header, shared by agent-runtime (Java, HeaderValue) and artifact-access (Go, store.DecodeHeaderValue). roundTrip: encode(value) is encoded and decode(encoded) is value. decodeOnly: decode(encoded) is value, though no encoder makes that encoded form.

roundTrip.name: ASCII that already looks percent-encoded is not touched
percent sign next to non-ASCII is escaped
ASCII that starts with the marker is encoded

decodeOnly.name: a value without the marker reads as it is
a bad escape reads as it is
a cut escape reads as it is
bytes that are not UTF-8 read as they are
